children: The Contractor appoints the Consultant to carry out the Services, subject to the terms of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The terms and conditions of this agreement and the warranties and undertakings which it contains are deemed to apply to all services performed and to be performed by the Consultant in relation to the Project both before and after the date of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants and undertakes that to the extent that any design of those elements of the Project falling within the Consultant’s professional discipline hasalready been undertaken by a third party prior to the date of this agreement, the Consultant hereby agrees and undertakes to accept full responsibility for that design as if it had been prepared by the Consultant as part of the Services on, and subject to, the terms of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor is entitled at any time to omit any part of the Services and, in the event of such omission, the Contractor shall not be liable to the Consultant for any losses, including loss of profits, as a result of the omission, including in circumstances where the Contractor has carried out the omitted Services themselves or employed an alternative consultant to carry out the omitted Services.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall provide the Services specified in {b:0}.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall, provide such additional services within the Consultant's discipline and competence as the Contractor may reasonably request in writing, relating to the Project.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall comply with all reasonable instructions given by the Contractor in writing in connection with this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants and undertakes that it shall:

children.name: text
children: comply with the terms of this agreement;

children.name: text
children: exercise the Required Standard when performing the Services;

children.name: text
children: exercise the Required Standard not to specify for use anything in the Project, which is Deleterious at the time of specification or use;

children.name: text
children: ensure that the design of all elements of the Project for which the Consultant is responsible complies with the Building Regulations, Building Safety Legislation and other applicable statutory and regulatory requirements;

children.name: text
children: ensure that the completed Project complies with all planning agreements, permissions and conditions;

children.name: text
children: carry out and fulfil, in all respects, the duties of a designer under the CDM Regulations and Building Safety Legislation;

children.name: text
children: co-operate with the Building Regulations Principal Designer, CDM Principal Designer, Building Regulations Principal Contractor and CDM Principal Contractor as required by the Building Regulations and CDM Regulations;

children.name: text
children: fulfil their responsibilities under the Building Safety Legislation and/or requirements of the Building Safety Regulator and/or Product Safety Regulator (as applicable) including without limitation any responsibilities as Dutyholder, including (but not limited to) providing the {BuildingHRNNonHRB} in order to allow:

children.name: text
children: commencement of the construction phase or relevant part of the Works (if applicable); and

children.name: text
children: Practical Completion of the Works, in accordance with the Building Safety Legislation and the Building Contract; and

children.name: text
children: notify the Contractor as soon as practicable if the Consultant or any sub-consultant has been subject to any serious sanction (whether in relation to the Project or otherwise) in respect of the Building Safety Legislation.

children.name: text
children: If, in the performance of its duties under this agreement, the Consultant becomes aware that it, or any other person, has specified or used, or authorised or approved the specification or use by others of anything which is Deleterious the Consultant will immediately give the Contractor written notice of the same. This {b:clause 4.2} does not create any additional duty for the Consultant to inspect or check the work of others which is not required by this agreement.

children.name: text
children: Where the Project is or includes works to a HRB, the Consultant shall not make any alteration to the Approved Plans or to the design of the Project that would result in a Controlled Change without first:

children.name: text
children: preparing details of the proposed change to the detail required by the HRB Procedures Regulations;

children.name: text
children: consulting with the Contractor, the Building Regulations Principal Designer, [the Building Regulations Principal Contractor and to each other consultant with design responsibility to consider the full impact of the proposed change;

children.name: text
children: complying with the applicable aspects of the Change Control Log; and

children.name: text
children: co-operating with the Building Regulations Principal Contractor where the Controlled Change must be submitted to the Building Safety Regulator for approval, including re-submission and/or appeal where the Regulator requests the Controlled Change, until such time as formal approval is provided under the Change Control Procedure and, where required, a Change Control Approval is received.

children.name: text
children: Where the Project is or includes works to a HRB, the Consultant shall:

children.name: text
children: establish and maintain a Mandatory Occurrence Reporting System and Mandatory Occurrence Reporting Plan in accordance with the Building Safety Legislation;

children.name: text
children: take reasonable steps to ensure each Reporting Person is provided with adequate instruction and information on the Mandatory Occurrence Reporting System and the incidents or situations that should be reported by the Reporting Person through the Mandatory Occurrence Reporting System:

children.name: text
children: in the case of a designer or contractor, before beginning any work in relation to the Project; and

children.name: text
children: in the case of any other person, as soon as reasonably practicable after first entering the site of the Project; and

children.name: text
children: in accordance with the Building Safety Legislation ensure an appropriate frequency of inspections of the Project for Safety Occurrences;

children.name: text
children: liaise and co-operate with each other to ensure that each Safety Occurrence is notified and reported to the Building Safety Regulator in accordance with the Building Safety Legislation; and

children.name: text
children: for each Safety Occurrence, consider whether a Controlled Change is necessary to remedy the Safety Occurrence. If a Controlled Change is required, the Consultant shall either:

children.name: text
children: make a Change Control Application or notify, as applicable, the Building Safety Regulator; or

children.name: text
children: liaise, as appropriate, with the Building Regulations Principal Contractor to make such Change Control Application or otherwise notify the Building Safety Regulator under the terms of its Building Contract;

children.name: text
children: when requested by the Contractor to do so, the Consultant shall promptly provide the Mandatory Occurrence Reporting Plan.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall forthwith upon becoming aware of a Safety Occurrence report the same to the Building Safety Regulator using the Mandatory Occurrence Reporting System and at the same time inform the Contractor and the Building Regulations Principal Contractor in writing with the appropriate references.

children.name: text
children: Where the Project is or includes works to a HRB the Consultant shall and ensure that each of its officers, employees, agents or authorised sub-consultants shall:

children.name: text
children: comply with the Golden Thread Procedures and the Building Regulations Principal Contractor's requirements for access to and use of the Golden Thread Facility;

children.name: text
children: include all design information within the Golden Thread Facility as required by regulation 31 of the HRB Procedures Regulations and ensure that design information for the Project produced before a building control application are provided to the Contractor;

children.name: text
children: where the Consultant is the Building Regulations Principal Designer, ensure that the Approved Plans are included within the Golden Thread Facility before the commencement of any works at the Site;

children.name: text
children: promptly and without charge provide all support, design documents, statements and certifications that may be required by:

children.name: text
children: the Accountable Person and/or Principal Accountable Person;

children.name: text
children: the Building Regulations Principal Contractor in support of an application for building control approval;

children.name: text
children: the Building Regulations Principal Contractor in support of an application for approval of a Controlled Change;

children.name: text
children: the Building Regulations Principal Contractor in support of an application for a completion certificate or a partial completion certificate;

children.name: text
children: the Contractor [and/or the Building Regulations Principal Designer] in support of an appeal against a Building Safety Regulator decision,

children.name: text
children: in each case pursuant to the requirements of the HRB Procedures Regulations.]

children.name: text
children: The Contractor will pay the Consultant the agreed sums set out in {b:Schedule 2} for all services, work and materials provided by the Consultant in accordance with this agreement.

children.name: text
children: If the Contractor intends to pay less than the sum notified by the Consultant, the Contractor shall give written notice to the Consultant not later than one (1) day prior to the final date for payment of the sum notified specifying the sum that the Contractor considers to be due on the date the notice is served, and the basis on which that sum is calculated.

children.name: text
children: The Fee shall be inclusive of all disbursements and other expenses incurred in the proper performance of the Services. Where the Project is or includes works to a HRB, the Fee is inclusive of all costs associated with or arising from compliance with the Building Safety Legislation and in all dealings with the Building Safety Regulator with regard to building control approval, Controlled Changes, completion certificates and in relation to the Building Safety Regulator decisions, inspections, approvals, requests for information and otherwise.

children.name: text
children: provided it remains available generally in the market to the Consultant (and/or members of the Consultant's profession engaged in services of a similar scope, size, nature and complexity as the Consultant) at commercially reasonable rates, shall maintain such insurance until the expiry of twelve years from the date of Practical Completion of the Works as established pursuant to the Building Contract (or such later period as may be required under the Limitation Act 1980 in respect of Section 1 or 2A of the Defective Premises Act 1972 and/or Section 38 of the Building Act 1984); and

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other term of this agreement the provision of collateral warranties and/or letters of reliance requested pursuant to {b:clause 7.1} shall be a condition precedent to the obligation of the Contractor to pay any sums to the Consultant under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Intellectual Property in all Material shall remain vested in the Consultant. The Consultant agrees to waive, and shall procure that any duly authorised sub-consultants waive, any right to be identified as author of the Material in accordance with section 77 of the Copyright, Designs and Patent Act 1988.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall have an unconditional, irrevocable, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-terminable licence (such licence to remain in full force and effect notwithstanding the completion of the Consultant's obligations or the termination of this agreement or the determination of the Consultant's engagement under this agreement or any dispute under this agreement) to copy and use the Material and to reproduce the designs and content of them for any purpose relating to the Project, including, without limitation, any of the Permitted Uses. Such licence will carry the right to grant sub-licences and will be transferable to third parties. The licence referred to in this {b:clause 8.2} allows the Contractor to use the Material in connection with any extension of the Project, but not to reproduce the designs contained in the Material in any such extension.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not be liable for any use the Contractor may make of the Material for any purpose other than the purposes for which they were originally prepared and the Permitted Uses.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant will not grant to any third party the right to use any of the Material save under any warranty it is obliged to give under this agreement or as otherwise required to enable it to fulfil its obligations under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant warrants that the Material (except to the extent that duly authorised sub-consultants are used) are the Consultant's own original work and that in any event their use in connection with the Project will not infringe the rights of any third party. The Consultant further warrants that where duly authorised sub-consultants are used their work will be original and will be covered by the licence granted to the Beneficiary under this {b:clause 8}. The Consultant shall indemnify the Contractor against all claims, liabilities and expenses arising out of any claim that use of the Material infringes the rights of any third party.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant agrees on reasonable request at any time and following reasonable prior written notice to give to the Contractor, or those authorised by the Contractor, access to the Material and to provide copies (including copy negatives and CAD disks) of the Material at the Contractor's expense.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant may not assign, sub-contract or otherwise transfer the whole or any part of the benefit of, or any of its rights or obligations under, this agreement without the Contractor's prior written consent (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld). Any sub-contracting to which the Contractor may consent will not in any way relieve the Consultant from its obligations and liabilities under this agreement.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor may assign the benefit of and its benefits and rights under this agreement to any person by way of absolute legal assignment without consent of the Consultant.

children.name: text
children: The Contractor shall be entitled to terminate the whole or any part of the Consultant's engagement in relation to the Project at any time by written notice served on the Consultant. In the event of termination, the Contractor will reimburse the Consultant such reasonable and proper parts of the Fee as is commensurate with the Services which the Consultant has performed up to the date of termination provided that proper records of expenditure have been kept and the values have been agreed with the Contractor. In the event of termination the Contractor shall not be liable for any loss of anticipated profit, loss of contracts or other losses and expenses arising by reason of or in connection with such termination.

children.name: text
children: The Consultant shall not cause or contribute to any breach by the Contractor of the Building Contract of which relevant extracts have been provided to the Consultant, and any other third party agreements provided by the Contractor to the Consultant, provided that, where the Contractor notifies the Consultant of any other third party agreement after the date of this agreement, the Consultant is not required to act in any way that may increase the Consultant's liability in excess of that which was reasonably foreseeable at the date of this agreement.

children.name: text
children: This agreement is not intended to confer any rights on any third party pursuant to the Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999.

children.name: text
children: Notwithstanding any other provision of this agreement either party may refer a dispute arising under this agreement to adjudication at any time under Part I of the Scheme for Construction Contracts (England and Wales) Regulations, which Part shall take effect as if it was incorporated into this clause.

children.name: text
children: The adjudicator shall be nominated by the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors.

children.name: text
children: Any notice to be given by either party under this agreement shall be sufficiently served if sent by hand or by post to the registered office or if there is none the last known address of the party to be served. Any notice sent by hand shall be deemed to be served on the date of delivery provided that if any notice sent by hand is sent after 5:00 p.m. on any day it shall be deemed to be served on the next Business Day. Any notice sent by post shall be deemed to have been duly served at the expiration of 48 hours after the time of posting if the end of that period falls before 5:00 p.m. on a Business Day and otherwise on the next Business Day.

children.name: text
children: Save to the extent the Sub-Consultant has a longer period of liability (whether to the Contractor or any third party) under the Limitation Act 1980 in respect of Section 1 or 2A of the Defective Premises Act 1972 and/or Section 38 of the Building Act 1984 (in which case the Consultant's liability under this agreement shall be extended to an equivalent period in respect of any such matter), the Parties agree that the Consultant's liability under this agreement shall continue and shall not cease until the expiry of 12 years after the date of Practical Completion and on that date such obligations and liabilities shall cease, but without prejudice to any matter, claim or dispute in relation to which legal proceedings were commenced prior to the expiry of such date.

children.name: text
children: This agreement and any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with it or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims) shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England.

children.name: text
children: Each party irrevocably agrees that the courts of England shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this agreement or its subject matter or formation (including non-contractual disputes or claims.

children.name: text
children: This agreement may be executed in any number of counterparts, each of which when executed and delivered shall constitute a duplicate original, but all the counterparts shall together constitute the one agreement.

children.name: text
children: No counterpart shall be effective until each party has executed and delivered at least one counterpart.
